method: Native browser SVG geometry; annotation background containment of later-painted points and 1,000 equal-distance close-path samples. This supplements actual raster inspection.
recognitionCaption: Fictional closes D1–D19; earlier closes 44 and 42 supply D1’s left-side comparisons. Swings use two earlier and two later closes. The D1–D6 projected line starts displaying at D8, when both anchor lows are confirmed. Point labels give session and close; the swing table names high/low status and recognition dates. D15’s low is recognized after D17, and D17’s high after D19.
